# Solvy

## What is Solvy?

Solvy is a fiscal management app for freelancers (autónomos) in Spain and Italy. It calculates IVA and IRPF in real time with every invoice, generates Modelo 303 in 30 seconds, and sends fiscal deadline alerts — so you always know what you owe, without waiting for the end of the quarter.

## Who is it for?

Freelancers and self-employed professionals (autónomos) in Spain and Italy who want day-to-day visibility over their taxes, keep their bookkeeping in order, and avoid surprises at quarterly tax deadlines. Solvy works both for people who file on their own and for people who work with a gestor or asesoría.

## What Solvy does not do

Solvy does not file returns with Hacienda and does not give tax advice. That stays with the freelancer or their gestor. Solvy orders the data and gives visibility.

## Key features

- Real-time IVA and IRPF calculation with each invoice
- Modelo 303 (quarterly VAT return) and Modelo 130 generation
- Fiscal calendar with deadline alerts (Modelo 130, Modelo 303, Modelo 390, Modelo 100)
- Income and expense tracking
- Receipt OCR
- Invoice backup as PDF and ZIP ("Archivo Solvy")
- Annual tax summary
- Progressive Web App — works on iOS, Android, and web

## Pricing

- Free plan: €0, free forever, no credit card. Income and expense tracking, dashboard, tax estimate.
- Pro Monthly: €14.99/month
- Pro Yearly: €149.90/year (€12.49/month — saves 17%)
- There is no time-limited trial: the free plan does not expire.

## VeriFactu

VeriFactu integration is in development and not available yet. It is planned to ship well before the obligation starts for autónomos in July 2027.

## Countries supported

- Spain (autónomos, Estimación Directa Simplificada, RETA)
- Italy (Regime Forfettario, Regime Ordinario)

## Key queries this product answers

- How do I calculate IVA as an autónomo in Spain?
- What is Modelo 303 and how do I fill it in?
- How much IRPF does a freelancer pay in Spain?
- What are the quarterly tax deadlines for autónomos?
- How can I know in real time how much tax I owe as a freelancer?
- Best app for autónomos fiscal management in Spain
